erweiterung_beschreibung.message: Explains settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center, Entra, Intune and Exchange, with recommendations and what differs from them.

seitenleiste_leer.message: There is no explanation for this page yet.

ausserhalb_hinweis.message: Open one of them, and the pilot explains the settings on that page.

ausserhalb_titel.message: The pilot works in these four portals

leer_vorschlag.message: Worth a look in this portal:

kein_portal.message: This tab is not one of the four admin portals.

erst_was.message: The pilot explains the setting you are looking at and tells you what we recommend.

erst_zusagen.message: It changes nothing and sends nothing from your portals. Everything stays in your browser.

erst_keine_pruefung.message: Not an audit, an explanation: it only reads what the page shows. The decision is yours.

grund_zeitgrenze.message: The page did not show the value.

grund_mehrdeutig.message: The setting appears more than once on the page. To avoid mixing them up, I do not rate it.

grund_unbekannt.message: I do not know the value shown, so I do not rate it.

grund_aufbau.message: The page looks different than expected. The explanation still applies, but I do not read the value.

grund_sprache.message: I only read values when the portal language is German or English.

neuladen_text.message: The page was already open when the pilot was added. After a reload it reads the values.

lizenz_entra_p1.message: Requires Microsoft Entra ID P1 (included in Microsoft 365 Business Premium).

zusage_kurz.message: Changes nothing. Sends nothing from your portals.

optionen_daten.message: Values it reads stay in your browser and are gone once you close the tab. The only thing stored is that you have read the introduction.

sprache.description: Sprache dieser Übersetzung; bestimmt die Sprache der Inhaltstexte (gleiche Wahl wie getMessage).

band_firma_text.message: Your organisation sets some of this guide’s settings.

ausblenden_hilfe.message: Is this deliberate for you? Then it no longer counts as a deviation. Undo here or in the settings.

werte_aus_firma.message: Your IT has switched off reading values. You see the explanations only.

optionen_ausgeblendet_leer.message: You have not hidden any notice.

optionen_firma_bewusst.message: Your IT has marked these deviations as deliberate:

optionen_werte_aus.message: Reading values: switched off by your IT.

zugriff_titel.message: The guide may not read this page

zugriff_text.message: Site access for $1 is restricted. Without it the guide cannot recognise the page or explain anything.

zugriff_weg.message: Allow access with the button. Or right-click the guide’s icon, “Can read and change site data”, then “On $1”.

zugriff_zusage.message: Even with access, the guide changes nothing and sends nothing from your portals.

zugriff_fehlt_titel.message: Site access is missing for these portals

zugriff_abgelehnt.message: Not allowed. You can try again at any time.

start_titel.message: How to open the Admin Pilot

start_schritt_1.message: Click the puzzle icon (Extensions) at the top right, next to the address bar.

start_schritt_2.message: Pin the Admin Pilot: in Chrome with the pin, in Edge with the eye (“Show in toolbar”). The icon then stays visible.

start_schritt_3.message: Open a Microsoft 365 admin center and click the icon. The panel opens to the right of the page.

start_zahl.message: A red number on the icon shows how many settings on the page differ from our recommendation.

stoerung_keine.message: Microsoft 365, Teams and Outlook: no outage reported. Checked at $1 (Berlin time).

stoerung_unbekannt.message: We could not fetch the Microsoft status just now. That does not rule out an outage.

optionen_stoerung_schalter.message: Show Microsoft outages on the icon

optionen_stoerung_text.message: Asks www.hagel-it.de for the Microsoft status every five minutes. Nothing from your portals is sent.

optionen_stoerung_was.message: If Microsoft reports an outage for Microsoft 365, Teams or Exchange Online, a red dot appears on the icon. Clicking the icon names the service and links to its status page.
